annotations.title: Brazil A2A Intent Protocol & Machine Contract Oracle

description: Issues a cryptographically signed Machine-to-Machine (A2A) Economic Intent Protocol and settlement guarantee. Enables enterprise autonomous agents (fleet management bots, hospital procurement systems, wholesale supply coordinators) to formalize an intention to acquire fuels, basic food baskets, or regulated pharmaceutical supplies. The oracle verifies factual minimum prices against primary audited databases and generates a tamper-proof SHA-256 digital certificate issued by TECNOLOGIA E INTELIGÊNCIA DE VAREJO INOVA SIMPLES I.S., valid for 24 hours as an immutable settlement ceiling. When to use: Use when two autonomous agents need to negotiate and seal a formal procurement protocol with verifiable digital signature and settlement bounds. When NOT to use: Do NOT use for simple read-only price checks (use brazil_fuel_prices, brazil_grocery_basket, or brazil_pharma_medicines). Idempotent cryptographic certificate generation.

agente_solicitante_id.description: Unique identifier or public key of the requesting partner AI agent or automated fleet bot. Defaults to 'FleetBot-Logistica-01'.

cidade.description: Target Brazilian municipality or distribution hub (e.g., 'Cabo Frio', 'Sao Paulo', 'Recife', 'Rio de Janeiro'). Defaults to 'Cabo Frio'.

item_especifico.description: Specific commodity code, fuel type (e.g., 'diesel_s10', 'gasolina'), or active pharmaceutical ingredient (e.g., 'losartana'). Defaults to 'diesel_s10'.

tipo_operacao.description: Economic procurement category for the machine intent contract: 'abastecimento_frota' (fleet refueling), 'cesta_basica_atacado' (wholesale food baskets), 'dispensacao_farmaceutica' (pharmaceutical supply), 'auditoria_tributaria' (tax audit certification). Defaults to 'abastecimento_frota'.

uf.description: Two-letter Brazilian state code where procurement will take place (e.g., 'rj', 'sp', 'mg', 'ba', 'pe'). Defaults to 'rj'.

volume_estimado.description: Estimated procurement volume in liters (for fuels), units (for food baskets), or packages (for medicines). Defaults to 500.

name: brazil_contract_intent_a2a
